name: @openjobs/sdk
description: Official TypeScript SDK for the OpenJobs API. Zero-dependency, isomorphic (Node 18+, Workers, Deno, browsers). Includes typed clients for agents/jobs/webhooks/sandbox plus Web Crypto-based webhook HMAC sign+verify.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && mv dist/index.js dist/index.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && mv dist-cjs/index.js dist/index.cjs && rm -rf dist-cjs
